reasons: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts, which is outside the accepted set (NY/DE/CA/E&W) and is an exclusive foreign venue — correctly classified as a deviation (walk-away territory), not a fallback.

The redline changes only the jurisdiction words and forum, substituting New York law and exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, which matches the preferred position exactly and preserves the sentence structure; the ~0.49 changed-character ratio is inherent to replacing a governing-law/venue sentence.
The edit is actionable and also resolves the internal conflict with Section 28.2 (New York County exclusive jurisdiction), leaving 28.2 and the escalation provision untouched.
The comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, and offers the Delaware/California/England and Wales fallback without lecturing.
